review: Manual review of current saved Blender renders and seven actual saved Unity captures. The chin flag remains FAIL because matching central contour calipers does not certify jaw/neck surface forms or head likeness.

ARMS_SIDE.note: Left/right profiles show closed rounded deltoid, upper-arm and forearm depth; wrist narrows continuously. No thin arm cards.

CHIN.note: The old beard/stubble cap is absent, and front throat/rear neck contour depth is closer to the fixed head-detail profile. Chin curvature, uneven jaw surface and neck/shoulder transition still differ visibly in all-around Blender and saved Unity captures; matching the sampled central calipers alone is insufficient for PASS.

FEET_SIDE.note: Both profiles show a rounded toe box, sloped instep, ankle and heel; a broad low sole can plant on the ground. No old twisted slab.

SHOULDERS.note: Full rounded deltoid at both arm joins. Folded front/rear deltoid/torso triangles were locally unfolded; the previous horizontal cavity/crease is absent in front, back and three-quarter proof.

WAIST.note: Waist tapers below the chest and widens toward the hips without the former waist shelf/love-handle ridge. Front/back and three-quarter views reviewed.
